mapper.sql: select a.draft_id, a.user_id, a.customer_org_id, a.device_id, a.knowledge_base_id, a.customer_name, a.device_name, a.serial_number, a.brand_name, a.model_name, a.knowledge_base_name, a.issue_description, a.answered, a.summary, a.troubleshooting_steps_json, a.safety_warnings_json, a.requires_on_site_service, a.refusal_reason, a.draft_title, a.draft_fault_description, a.draft_priority, a.assignee_user_id, u.user_name as assignee_user_name, u.nick_name as assignee_nick_name, a.work_order_remark, a.citations_json, a.tool_trace_json, a.model_name_used, a.status, a.work_order_id, w.work_order_no, a.confirmed_time, a.del_flag, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.remark from oc_agent_draft a left join sys_user u on u.user_id = a.assignee_user_id left join oc_work_order w on w.work_order_id = a.work_order_id
mapper.insert: insert into oc_agent_draft ( user_id, customer_org_id, device_id, knowledge_base_id, customer_name, device_name, serial_number, brand_name, model_name, knowledge_base_name, issue_description, answered, summary, troubleshooting_steps_json, safety_warnings_json, requires_on_site_service, refusal_reason, draft_title, draft_fault_description, draft_priority, assignee_user_id, work_order_remark, citations_json, tool_trace_json, model_name_used, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{userId}, #{customerOrgId}, #{deviceId}, #{knowledgeBaseId}, #{customerName}, #{deviceName}, #{serialNumber}, #{brandName}, #{modelName}, #{knowledgeBaseName}, #{issueDescription}, #{answered}, #{summary}, #{troubleshootingStepsJson}, #{safetyWarningsJson}, #{requiresOnSiteService}, #{refusalReason}, #{draftTitle}, #{draftFaultDescription}, #{draftPriority}, #{assigneeUserId}, #{workOrderRemark}, #{citationsJson}, #{toolTraceJson}, #{modelNameUsed}, #{status}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update oc_agent_draft set draft_title = #{draftTitle}, draft_fault_description = #{draftFaultDescription}, draft_priority = #{draftPriority}, assignee_user_id = #{assigneeUserId}, work_order_remark = #{workOrderRemark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where draft_id = #{draftId} and user_id = #{userId} and status = '0' and del_flag = '0'

update oc_agent_draft set status = '1', work_order_id = #{workOrderId}, confirmed_time = sysdate(), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where draft_id = #{draftId} and user_id = #{userId} and status = '0' and work_order_id is null and del_flag = '0'
